content.en: Researchers have developed algorithms that can assess and classify various aspects of degenerative spine diseases using routine magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). These algorithms provide new techniques for evaluating intervertebral disc degeneration, including T2 mapping, T2* mapping, and spin-spin relaxation time (T2) cut-off values. Additionally, computer-aided classification software has been developed to assist in the detection and classification of lumbar spine diseases. These advancements aim to improve the accuracy and standardization of MRI findings for degenerative spine diseases.
content.da: Forskere har udviklet algoritmer, der kan vurdere og klassificere forskellige aspekter af degenerative ryghvirvelsygdomme ved hjælp af rutinemæssig magnetisk resonansbilleddannelse (MRI). Disse algoritmer leverer nye teknikker til evaluering af intervertebralt diskdegeneration, herunder T2 mapping, T2* mapping og spin-spin afslapningstid (T2) grænseværdier. Derudover er der udviklet computerstyret klassifikationssoftware til at hjælpe med detektion og klassifikation af lænderygsygdomme. Disse fremskridt sigter mod at forbedre nøjagtigheden og standardiseringen af MRI-resultater for degenerative ryghvirvelsygdomme.

critic.en: Can you believe we're basically handing over the keys to our medical diagnoses to algorithms? MRI has been this sacred tool for radiologists, and now we're just casually offering it up to some pieces of code. Those machines don’t share our human intuition and empathy.
critic.da: Aftalebrud! Vi kan ikke overlade noget så vigtigt som diagnose og behandling til nogle algoritmer, der ikke har erfaring... masser af problemer vent.

potential.en: The applications of machine learning in the medical field are truly exciting. These algorithms have the potential to revolutionize how we diagnose and treat patients, providing more accurate and timely assessments. The work done in developing algorithms for assessing and classifying degenerative spine diseases is a great example of how technology can be used to make a real impact in healthcare. By leveraging the power of machine learning, we are able to analyze medical images in a way that was not possible before, providing new insights and opportunities for improving patient care. I'm thrilled to see the progress that has been made in this area and look forward to the continued development of these technologies.
potential.da: Det er fantastisk at se, hvordan teknologien kan revolutionere diagnoser inden for rygsygdomme! Algoritmerne til klassificering af degenerative rygsygdomme på MR-scanninger kan bidrage til en mere præcis og ensartet vurdering, hvilket er afgørende for patienterne. Jeg håber, at denne udvikling vil blive taget i brug i klinisk praksis for at forbedre behandlingen af mennesker med rygproblemer.
